 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Zone 1: Factory Floor Edge Zone
 subgraph Zone1 [\"FACTORY FLOOR EDGE ZONE (Untrusted / High Density)\"]
 Scanners[\"Rugged Scanners / RFID Readers\"]
 EdgeRouter[\"Edge API Router\"]
 Scanners -- \"WPA3 Enterprise / mTLS\" --> EdgeRouter
 end

 %% Zone 2: Private Application Zone
 subgraph Zone2 [\"PRIVATE APPLICATION ZONE (Kubernetes Microservices Cluster)\"]
 APIGW[\"API Gateway / WAF\"]
 IngestGo[\"Scanner Ingestion Microservice (Go)\"]
 Kafka[\"Kafka Event Bus\"]
 DigitalTwin[\"Digital Twin Engine (Java/Spring Boot)\"]
 IngestPy[\"Supplier Ingestion Microservice (Python)\"]

 APIGW --> IngestGo
 IngestGo --> Kafka
 APIGW --> DigitalTwin
 APIGW --> IngestPy
 end

 %% Zone 3: Secure Data & Hardware Vault Zone
 subgraph Zone3 [\"SECURE DATA & HARDWARE VAULT ZONE\"]
 Postgres[\"PostgreSQL - Encrypted DB\"]
 Ledger[\"Immutable QLDB Ledger\"]
 HSM[\"Cloud/On-Prem HSM\"]

 Postgres <---> Ledger
 Ledger <---> HSM
 end

 %% Inter-Zone Connections
 EdgeRouter -- \"Encrypted gRPC / TLS 1.3\" --> APIGW
 Zone2 -- \"Encrypted SQL / TLS 1.3\" --> Postgres
 Zone2 -- \"PKCS#11 API\" --> HSM

 %% Optional Styling
 classDef default fill:#f9f9f9,stroke:#333,stroke-width:1px;
 classDef edgeStyle stroke:#1E88E5,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef appStyle stroke:#43A047,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef vaultStyle stroke:#E53935,stroke-width:2px;

 class Zone1 edgeStyle;
 class Zone2 appStyle;
 class Zone3 vaultStyle;",
 "config": null
